build.command: git ls-files 'src/*.ts' 'adapters/*.ts' 'bin/*.ts' | while read f; do bun build "$f" --target=bun --outfile=/dev/null >/dev/null || exit 1; done

unlabelled_fixtures.command: for f in test/fixtures/*.jsonl; do n=$(basename $f .jsonl); grep -q "$n" test/calibrate.ts || echo "UNLABELLED $n"; done

missing_docs.command: grep -o 'docs/[a-z-]*\.txt' llms.txt | sort -u | while read d; do [ -f "$d" ] || echo "MISSING $d"; done
